description: Narrows a test run to the tests that could notice a change, from facts in the source rather than a prediction: a test runs when it imports a changed file, reaches one through another module, is itself edited by the change, reads the repository at run time, or has failed recently. It refuses to narrow at all - and says why - when the change touches dependencies, build or test configuration, shared setup or fixtures, when the suite drives a browser, or when a changed file cannot be traced to any test. Use it to run the right tests quickly; what it leaves out, it leaves out for a stated reason.

diff.description: A git range, e.g. main...HEAD (the default)

files.description: The changed files, when they do not come from a git range

project.description: Absolute path of the project folder

name: which_tests_to_run
title: Which tests could notice this change?
